propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no generic retry wrapper, duck-typed fallback, or legacy write swallowing reachable in production.
Unsupported production mutations must fail with a typed provider-neutral error before any local or remote effects occur.

Preview, manifest, and log output must preserve existing mutation fields and add versioned, redacted sections for lifecycle intent, logical attempts, delay/budget, disposition, fuse state, and retry_not_before.

State advancement (cursor, baseline, binding) must only occur for proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown mutations must never be counted as applied and remain recoverable.

The pre-observation repair call in reconcile.py must remain ordered after staleness validation (ensure_selection_current) and before the first remote fetch (fetcher.fetch_snapshot / compute_snapshot).

Portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end tests must cover success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent failure, auth/provider stop, fuse lifecycle, create containment, restart, and delivery failure without external credentials.
